description: Stage 1.5 of the A=4 binding-K search: the canonical AVERAGED interface operator on the naive {3,6,9} placement, via linearity (8 plain GP words, exact q-Laurent, 50 dps). Captures 96.2% of the canonical 4He trace (rel 3.8%, vs 14.7% plain); the residual is the measured woven color-tube structure. Scope-(a); no fit.
verdict: Stage 1.5: the averaged 3-bond operator K_avg = ⊗(σ+σ⁻¹)/2 on the naive inter-nucleon interfaces gives tr_M(cp·K_avg) = 0.0574618494514 vs the canonical 0.0553584262668 — rel Δ = 0.038 (96.2% captured; plain best was 14.7%). The residual 3.8% is the measured woven color-tube structure of the canonical recipe (9 averaged crossings at {1,2,4,5,6,7,10}) beyond the naive {3,6,9} placement. A=4 factorization T ≈ cp·K_avg holds to 3.8% — honest partial identification. No AME; no fit; nothing wired. Scope-(a).
scope: (a) — averaged 3-bond partial identification; woven-structure residual 3.8% measured

assertions.label: averaged interface improves on plain best (3.8% < 14.7%)
